objective: Settle all fills from one native OCLOB matching round atomically and advance all seven private heads only after independently observing every matched slot.
truth_provider: Separate corporate containers, actual seven-party MP-SPDZ proof persistence, per-member committee certificates, native DeFMI VM on five Avalanche validators, node-owned canonical reads and validator restart.
hard_constraints: One maker legal entity reserves two separate sell orders of 60 each against its 120-unit facility; one taker reserves buy 90 at a maximum 101. Actual expected fills are 60 at 100 and 30 at 101.
Every signing node derives complete ordered membership from its own completed round, never a coordinator-provided subset. Extracted member signing and standalone settlement are rejected.
One canonical transaction applies both members with a common parent; the second fill uses the cumulative taker remainder and exact prior signed receipt.
All seven nodes observe both accepted members before advancing the private book. A partial set and altered finality fail without state change. Exact retry does not settle twice.
Maker/taker facility sequences finish at 4/3; five validator roots agree and survive one actual validator restart.
All builds and tests run on Softbank or Omen. No raw order capability is opened and no participant signature is required after matching.
non_claims: One operator host and two corporations, not two independent maker firms or independent operators/WAN.
This scenario does not redeem the five claims or perform a second match. The original single-fill wallet/reuse scenario remains a separate regression gate.
No new cryptographic primitive, production promotion, cross-DeFMI atomicity, exhaustive eight-fill performance or UI acceptance. The configured canonical reader remains a trust boundary.
